note: The Start a Relationship journey as data (docs/BRAND-BRIEF.md section 5, deliverable 6). The implementer pastes this object into assets/js/data.js as the key journeys (plain JSON is valid ES5) and renders it from V.contact. Every field name is a field of shared/lead-schema.json; the only new field is org_type (Institutions path). The form posted is contact, so the Netlify Forms copy, the function core, the dedupe, the score and the Pipedrive routing stay as built. Copy is final: British English, no em dash in any form, nothing invented; every placeholder is marked To confirm. Strings with {division} are filled at run time from the routing name of the chosen division.
title: Start a relationship
description: Start a relationship with Imperial Holdings Group. Three paths: private clients, professional partners, institutions. One person reads your message and replies personally.

journey.note: Chooses the path and skips the chooser. Maps to the audience field.

audience.note: Alias of journey, kept for existing links (event pages link ?about=group&audience=institutions today).

about.note: Prefills the division and skips the first screen of the path; also selects the path when journey is absent (see prefill.byDivision).

via.note: The entry point, free text from the entries list below. It is not a form field: it stays in the page URL, which the page field carries into the Pipedrive note (page: .../contact?about=citizenship&via=division-hero).

goals.note: Kept from the house finder: comma separated goal keys, written into interests as today.

title: Start a relationship.
chooser.lead: Tell us a little about yourself and what you have in mind. One person at Imperial will read it and reply personally. Three paths; choose the one that describes you.
chooser.question: I am

paths.title: Private Clients
paths.text: Individuals and families: a second residency or citizenship, a home in Dubai, or the continuing support of the Private Office.

paths.title: Professional Partners
paths.text: Lawyers, bankers, advisers and family offices who introduce Clients, and Partner teams who will train with Imperial Academy.

paths.title: Institutions and Strategic Relationships
paths.text: Governments, missions, institutions and organisations exploring a relationship with the Group.

chooser.footnote: Not sure which? Begin as a private client and we will take it from there.
chooser.why: The path is the audience: it sets the Contact Type in Pipedrive (Client, Partner or none for institutions), which screens follow, and which questions are never asked.

journeys.name: Private Clients
journeys.opening: Tell us what you have in mind. We will bring in the right house, and one person will be your point of contact throughout.

screens.title: What brings you to Imperial?
screens.lead: Choose the closest. It decides which house reads your message.

fields.label: It concerns

options.s: For me, or for my family

options.l: Continuing support as an existing Imperial Client
A home or property in Dubai
options.s: Imperial Real Estate, not yet launched

options.l: Something broader, or I am not yet sure
options.s: The Group brings in the right house

fields.why: The one answer that routes. It chooses the division, its owner in Pipedrive, the record type (lead or deal) and the pipeline. Nothing else on the path routes.

screens.title: Who is this for, and where do you live?
screens.lead: So the right office replies, and the conversation starts in the right place.

fields.name: for_whom
fields.label: This is for

options.s: If you introduce clients professionally, the Professional Partners path is the one for you.

fields.why: Who it is for shapes the first conversation and, for a client being introduced, the path: the page offers the Partners path, where the introduction is recorded as a referral. The field is kept either way.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country of residence
fields.why: Residence decides which office replies (Dubai or Lagos) and which routes are open. It is written to the Pipedrive person when it matches a country option, otherwise kept in the note.

fields.name: nationality
fields.label: Nationality, or nationalities (optional)
fields.hint: It helps us prepare, and you may leave it for the conversation.
fields.why: The one personal detail that changes what can be prepared for a residency or citizenship conversation. Asked only on those two routes, never required.

screens.title: Timing
screens.lead: A rough sense is enough. Nothing here commits you to anything.

fields.name: timeline
fields.label: When would you like to begin?
fields.why: The strongest signal in the lead score, and it sets Urgency and the expected close date in Pipedrive. The labels are the schema labels, so the page and the note say the same thing.

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Is there a budget in mind? (optional)
fields.hint: A broad band is enough. It only helps us prepare the right options, and you may leave it for the conversation.

options.l: I would rather not say yet

fields.tbc: Bands and currency come from docs/BUILD-CONTRACT.md 4.2, not from the brief (To confirm, Founder).
fields.why: The only question about money on the site. A band, optional, and asked only where it helps a route (citizenship programmes and property), never for the Private Office or the Group. It feeds the score and nothing else.

fields.name: re_intent
fields.label: I am looking to
fields.why: Buy or rent changes who at Real Estate replies and what is prepared. Kept optional because the division has not launched.

fields.name: re_area
fields.label: Area, if you have one in mind (optional)
fields.why: Written into Service Requested so the team sees it at a glance.

journeys.name: Professional Partners
journeys.opening: Your client stays your client. Tell us how you would like to work with Imperial, and one person who knows Partner practices will reply.

screens.title: How would you like to work with Imperial?

fields.name: about
fields.label: I would like to

options.s: With their permission, and on written terms
Join the network of introducers and advisers

fields.why: Routes to Partners Club or Academy. An introduction sets for_whom to client, which the core records as Request Type Referral and scores as a referral; a request to join does not. The prefill from the Partners Club page lands on this screen with nothing chosen, because the two Partners Club options route the same way but are recorded differently.
